projectFrame.pageJob: Convey untouched wilderness, old-world safari romance and restorative stillness; funnel everything toward a personal enquiry rather than a self-serve booking engine.
projectFrame.emotionalReference: Cinematic golden-age safari photography — muted earth tones, slow dawns, wide silences. Think Isak Dinesen's prose pace, not a resort brochure.
projectFrame.designCharacter: Editorial, media-led luxury: full-viewport photography carries the page, chrome disappears, generous slow whitespace, one warm brass accent used sparingly.
projectFrame.referenceDesignThesis: The interface retreats so the landscape performs: oversized serene imagery, hairline structure, and measured pacing turn browsing the page into something close to being there.
projectFrame.antiPattern: Anything that reads 'resort website': uniform card grids of activities, orange BOOK NOW badges, price stickers, stock-cheerful copy, over-saturated imagery.

designDna: Media leads, chrome disappears: the first viewport is a full-bleed photograph with no boxes around content and a transparent header.
Whitespace is the layout: sections breathe with at least 15vh vertical padding and isolated statements max out at 65ch.
Slow is luxurious: transitions live in the 300-1200ms bands; nothing snaps instantly.
Editorial asymmetry, never grids of cards: content composes in focal-point layouts; the one repeating-row section uses hairline rules, not cards.
Monochrome plus photography does the color work: charcoal ground, warm off-white ink, one brass accent reserved for kickers, indices and hover states.
A serif speaks, a sans whispers: display serif carries emotion at weight 500-600 (never bold); the sans handles UI and body at 300-500.
Every primary CTA opens the same enquiry surface — one conversion path, no competing funnels.

colors.usage: Dark charcoal page and section ground on photographic masses
Primary text and headlines on the dark ground
Reserved accent: kickers, indices, hover states, hairlines
Soft accent tint for large hover fills and emphasis on pale surfaces
Translucent brass structure rules on pale surfaces
Translucent ink structure rules on dark surfaces
Form errors and destructive states only

display.weightGuidance: 500-600 only; never bold; generous letter-spacing on kickers

shape.borderRadius: 0 everywhere — sharp architectural edges are part of the identity
shape.shadowPolicy: No drop shadows; depth comes exclusively from scrim gradients over media (transparent to rgba(26,26,24,0.7))
shape.texture: Subtle global film grain (SVG turbulence, ~4% opacity, fixed overlay, pointer-events none)

layout.containerWidth: max-width 1200px with 24px gutters; full-bleed for photographic sections
layout.sectionSpacing: min 15vh vertical padding between sections; 40vh+ isolation around major statements
layout.imageTreatment: Full-bleed or large editorial crops; scrim gradients for text-over-image; slight slow scale (1.03) on hover; 0 radius

header.layout: Fixed minimal bar: wordmark left, menu trigger right, enquiry CTA far right
states: [OBSERVED] Transparent over hero with ink-colored text
Solid ground-color background with hairline bottom border after ~100vh of scroll
Hides on scroll down past 300px, returns on scroll up (400ms ease-out)
Solid while any overlay is open

navigation.desktop: Sparse inline links (Home, About, Services, Contact) with animated underline-grow on hover; right-aligned
navigation.mobile: Full-screen ground-color takeover, centered column of large serif links, staggered 60ms fade-up; closes via X, Escape or scrim click

globalChrome.primaryCta: Capsule-outline 'Enquire' button in accent color; opens the enquiry form; identical behavior from header, hero and closing band
globalChrome.footer: Four columns on ground color: brand mark + address, primary nav echo, contact block, social links; hairline top border; legal line with dynamically sourced year
globalChrome.formBehavior: Enquiry form validates on blur, shows accent-colored error text under fields, success state replaces the form with a quiet confirmation line; Escape, scrim click and an explicit close button all dismiss
globalChrome.overlays: Full-screen menu and enquiry drawer share a 60% scrim; panel slides in 1000ms ease-out-expo; body scroll locks while open

interactions.effect: accent color + underline grows from left
background fills accent, text flips to ground color
hamburger lines morph to X, full-screen menu fades in with slight scale

motion.scrollBehavior: [INFERRED] Native scroll with gentle lerp smoothing (~0.1); disabled on touch devices and under prefers-reduced-motion
motion.reducedMotion: All animation and parallax disabled globally; reveals render in final state; scroll smoothing off; page fully readable with motion removed

hero.purpose: Immediate transport — establish scale, solitude and wilderness in one image
hero.layout: 100svh full-bleed photograph, centered wordmark + subtitle over a bottom scrim, scroll indicator at the base
hero.visualMass: one full viewport; the largest single media element on the site
hero.typography: Hero H1 serif + one-line sans subtitle, generous letter-spacing
hero.responsive: 80svh on tablet, 70svh on phone; subtitle wraps; CTA stays visible above the fold
hero.mediaTreatment: single dominant landscape photograph, subject weighted right, dark lower third for text

sections.name: Introduction Statement
sections.purpose: Emotional positioning — quiet luxury and stillness, not amenities
sections.layout: 100vh centered single statement, max 65ch, kicker above
sections.visualMass: one viewport, almost entirely empty space
sections.typography: Statement serif; kicker in sans caps with accent color
sections.cta: Accent text link to the experiences section
sections.responsive: Auto height with generous padding on mobile; type scales down via clamp

sections.name: Chapters Collection
sections.purpose: The signature section — the offered experience told as five named chapters, not a card grid
sections.layout: Five full-width hairline rows; row number left, chapter title center in large serif, short descriptor right
sections.visualMass: roughly 1.5 viewport heights — the largest informational mass on the page
sections.surface: ground color with hairline rules; on hover a photographic preview fades in beside the cursor
sections.typography: Chapter titles in display serif at H2 scale; indices in accent sans
sections.media: one photograph per chapter, revealed on hover/focus, never tiled as cards
sections.cta: Each row expands to a detail overlay with a single 'Explore this chapter' link
sections.responsive: Rows stack vertically on touch; tap expands the detail overlay full-screen (no hover dependency)

sections.name: Location Split
sections.purpose: Ground the camp geographically — landscape context and journey
sections.layout: 60/40 asymmetric split: photograph left, editorial text right, on one viewport
sections.typography: Section H2 + short body block, max 55ch
sections.media: single wide landscape photograph, full-height crop
sections.cta: Text link to the contact page
sections.responsive: Stacks image-over-text below 768px; image keeps 4:3 crop

sections.name: Closing Enquiry Band
sections.layout: 100vh centered statement over a dimmed full-bleed photograph
sections.typography: Section H2 serif + one-line sans support

hero.purpose: Continuity: a quieter photographic header that keeps the home language
hero.layout: 50svh full-bleed photograph with bottom-aligned page title over scrim

sections.name: Story Editorial
sections.purpose: Narrate the place and its philosophy in alternating image/text compositions
sections.layout: Three asymmetric image/text rows alternating sides, generous 15vh separation
sections.media: one photograph per row, editorial crop

hero.purpose: Frame the offering in one calm statement

sections.name: Offering Rows
sections.purpose: Present each experience in the chapter-row language — hierarchy without cards
sections.layout: Hairline-separated rows: index, offering title (serif), two-line description, discreet link
sections.visualMass: roughly 1.5 viewports; the page's informational mass
sections.typography: Row titles at H3 serif; body in sans 300
sections.responsive: Rows collapse to title+description stack on mobile

hero.purpose: A direct, personal invitation to enquire
hero.layout: 40svh quiet photographic header with page title

sections.name: Enquiry Form + Details
sections.purpose: The conversion surface plus human-readable contact facts
sections.layout: 60/40 split: form left (name, email, message), contact details right on pale panel
sections.typography: Labels in sans 500 caps; inputs on ground with hairline borders; focus in accent
sections.cta: Capsule submit button; success replaces form with a confirmation line

signatureElements: Full-bleed photographic hero with transparent header and scrim-set serif wordmark
Hairline chapter/row language with accent indices instead of cards
One warm brass accent reserved for kickers, indices and hover states on a near-monochrome field
Alternating dark photographic interruptions between calm ground-color sections
Serif display voice against quiet sans UI at deliberately different scales
antiPatterns: No uniform card grids for activities or offerings
No bright orange booking badges, price stickers or urgency banners
No invented client logos, award badges or testimonial identities
No glassmorphism, gradient decoration or drop shadows
No bold display weights — the serif never exceeds 600

responsive.desktop: Full asymmetric layouts; 100svh photographic sections; inline navigation; hover interactions active
responsive.tablet: 768-1023px: splits stack, chapters rows remain but hover previews become tap overlays; header keeps CTA
responsive.mobile: Single column; 70svh heroes; type scales via clamp; full-screen menu takeover; hover-dependent behaviors replaced by tap; no horizontal overflow at 390px

accessibility.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion disables reveals, parallax, smoothing and hover scale globally; content renders static and complete
accessibility.focusVisible: 2px accent outline with 3px offset on every interactive element
accessibility.keyboardNavigation: Header links, menu trigger, chapter rows, form fields and CTA reachable in DOM order; Escape closes any overlay
accessibility.forms: Every input has a visible label; errors announced under fields; success state is a text node
accessibility.performance: Hero photograph is the LCP candidate; below-the-fold images lazy-load; fonts use font-display swap with system fallbacks

acceptanceChecklist: Hero occupies approximately one viewport on desktop with a transparent header over it
Hero headline is never clipped at any breakpoint
Sections alternate dark, pale and photographic surfaces in a recognizable rhythm
The chapters/offering rows use hairline rules — no uniform card grids anywhere
Display serif never exceeds weight 600 and scales via clamp()
Brass accent appears only on kickers, indices, links and hover states
Every primary CTA leads to the enquiry form
No client names, awards or trust badges appear beyond the supplied Business Facts
Mobile header and menu feel continuous with the desktop language
Images carry scrim-set text without contrast failure (WCAG AA on overlaid copy)
No horizontal overflow at 1440, 768 and 390px widths
prefers-reduced-motion renders the page fully without any animation
Every image slot renders a real bundled image (no provider URLs, no broken slots)
Contact form posts to the platform Form Service with the hidden siteFormId
Footer legal line sources its year dynamically
